statement: Observed improvements in temporal-aware retrieval could be confounded by enhancements to semantic matching components rather than the temporal modeling itself, especially when using learned combinations that may absorb semantic improvements.

evidence.quote: Re3 focuses on general temporal IR benchmarks; our idea targets versioned regulatory documents for open-domain QA, proposing a retrieval-agnostic temporal relevance component adaptable to any retriever.
